verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἐφανέρωσεν ἑαυτὸν πάλιν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Τιβεριάδος ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ οὕτως
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta ephanerōsen heauton palin ho Iēsous tois mathētais epi tēs thalassēs tēs Tiberiados ephanerōsen de houtōs
verses.literal: Later . . . by the Sea of Tiberias Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples He made Himself known in this way
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, Jesus tornou a manifestar-se aos discípulos na praia do mar de Tiberíades; e manifestou-se deste modo:

verses.original: ἦσαν ὁμοῦ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος καὶ Ναθαναὴλ ὁ ἀπὸ Κανᾶ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ οἱ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ ἄλλοι ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ δύο
verses.transliteration: ēsan homou Simōn Petros kai Thōmas ho legomenos Didymos kai Nathanaēl ho apo Kana tēs Galilaias kai hoi tou Zebedaiou kai alloi ek tōn mathētōn autou dyo
verses.literal: Simon Peter Thomas called Didymus Nathanael from Cana in Galilee the sons of Zebedee and two other - disciples were together
verses.literalPt: Simão Pedro, Tomé, chamado Dídimo, Natanael, que era de Caná da Galileia, os filhos de Zebedeu e outros dois de seus discípulos estavam juntos.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτοῖς Σίμων Πέτρος Ὑπάγω ἁλιεύειν Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Ἐρχόμεθα καὶ ἡμεῖς σὺν σοί ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐνέβησαν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ νυκτὶ ἐπίασαν οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: legei autois Simōn Petros Hypagō halieuein Legousin autō Erchometha kai hēmeis syn soi exēlthon kai enebēsan eis to ploion kai en ekeinē tē nykti epiasan ouden
verses.literal: Simon Peter told them I am going fishing We will go with you they said So they went out and got into the boat but caught nothing that night
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Simão Pedro: Vou pescar. Disseram-lhe os outros: Também nós vamos contigo. Saíram, e entraram na barca, e naquela noite nada apanharam.

verses.original: Πρωΐας δὲ ἤδη γενομένης ἔστη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸν αἰγιαλόν οὐ μέντοι ᾔδεισαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Prōias de ēdē genomenēs estē Iēsous eis ton aigialon ou mentoi ēdeisan hoi mathētai hoti Iēsous estin
verses.literal: Early in the morning . . . . . . Jesus stood on the shore but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus
verses.literalPt: Mas, ao romper do dia, estava Jesus na praia; todavia, os discípulos não sabiam que era ele.

verses.original: λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Παιδία μή τι προσφάγιον ἔχετε Ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ Οὔ
verses.transliteration: legei oun autois ho Iēsous Paidia mē ti prosphagion echete Apekrithēsan autō Ou
verses.literal: So He called out to them Children do you have any fish No they answered
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhes Jesus: Moços, apanhastes algum peixe? Responderam-lhe: Não.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Βάλετε εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ μέρη τοῦ πλοίου τὸ δίκτυον καὶ εὑρήσετε ἔβαλον οὖν καὶ οὐκέτι αὐτὸ ἑλκύσαι ἴσχυον ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ἰχθύων
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Balete eis ta dexia merē tou ploiou to diktyon kai heurēsete ebalon oun kai ouketi auto helkysai ischyon apo tou plēthous tōn ichthyōn
verses.literal: He told them Cast the net on the right side of the boat and you will find some So they cast it there and they were unable to haul it in . . . because of the great number of fish
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes ele: Lançai a rede à direita da barca, e achareis. Lançaram-na, pois, e já não podiam puxá-la por causa do grande número de peixes.

verses.original: Λέγει οὖν ὁ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ Πέτρῳ Ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος ἀκούσας ὅτι ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν τὸν ἐπενδύτην διεζώσατο ἦν γὰρ γυμνός καὶ ἔβαλεν ἑαυτὸν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: Legei oun ho mathētēs ekeinos hon ēgapa ho Iēsous tō Petrō Ho Kyrios estin Simōn oun Petros akousas hoti ho Kyrios estin ton ependytēn diezōsato ēn gar gymnos kai ebalen heauton eis tēn thalassan
verses.literal: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter It is the Lord As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it . . . ) and jumped . . . into the sea
verses.literalPt: O discípulo a quem Jesus amava disse a Pedro: É o Senhor! Simão Pedro, quando ouviu que era o Senhor, tomou a sua veste (porque se havia despido) e lançou-se ao mar;

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἄλλοι μαθηταὶ τῷ πλοιαρίῳ ἦλθον οὐ γὰρ ἦσαν μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἀπὸ πηχῶν διακοσίων σύροντες τὸ δίκτυον τῶν ἰχθύων
verses.transliteration: hoi de alloi mathētai tō ploiariō ēlthon ou gar ēsan makran apo tēs gēs alla hōs apo pēchōn diakosiōn syrontes to diktyon tōn ichthyōn
verses.literal: The other disciples came ashore in the boat They dragged in the net full of fish for they were not far from land only about a hundred yards . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: mas os outros discípulos vieram na barquinha, puxando a rede com os peixes; porque estavam afastados da terra somente cerca de duzentos cúbitos.

verses.original: Ὡς οὖν ἀπέβησαν εἰς τὴν γῆν βλέπουσιν ἀνθρακιὰν κειμένην καὶ ὀψάριον ἐπικείμενον καὶ ἄρτον
verses.transliteration: Hōs oun apebēsan eis tēn gēn blepousin anthrakian keimenēn kai opsarion epikeimenon kai arton
verses.literal: When they landed . . . . . . . . . they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it and some bread
verses.literalPt: Ao saltarem em terra, viram ali umas brasas, e um peixe posto em cima delas, e pão.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐνέγκατε ἀπὸ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὧν ἐπιάσατε νῦν
verses.transliteration: Legei autois ho Iēsous Enenkate apo tōn opsariōn hōn epiasate nyn
verses.literal: Jesus told them Bring some of the fish you have just caught
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Trazei alguns dos peixes que acabastes de apanhar.

verses.original: ἀνέβη οὖν Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ εἵλκυσεν τὸ δίκτυον εἰς τὴν γῆν μεστὸν ἰχθύων μεγάλων ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα τριῶν καὶ τοσούτων ὄντων οὐκ ἐσχίσθη τὸ δίκτυον
verses.transliteration: anebē oun Simōn Petros kai heilkysen to diktyon eis tēn gēn meston ichthyōn megalōn hekaton pentēkonta triōn kai tosoutōn ontōn ouk eschisthē to diktyon
verses.literal: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore It was full of large fish 153 . . . . . . but even with so many the net was not torn
verses.literalPt: Simão Pedro entrou na barca e puxou a rede à terra, cheia de cento e cinquenta e três grandes peixes; e, apesar de serem tantos, não se rompeu a rede.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δεῦτε ἀριστήσατε οὐδεὶς δὲ ἐτόλμα τῶν μαθητῶν ἐξετάσαι αὐτόν Σὺ τίς εἶ εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Legei autois ho Iēsous Deute aristēsate oudeis de etolma tōn mathētōn exetasai auton Sy tis ei eidotes hoti ho Kyrios estin
verses.literal: Come have breakfast Jesus said to them None of the disciples dared to ask Him Who are You They knew it was the Lord
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Vinde almoçar. Nenhum dos discípulos ousava perguntar-lhe: Quem és tu? Pois sabiam que era o Senhor.

verses.original: ἔρχεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ λαμβάνει τὸν ἄρτον καὶ δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὸ ὀψάριον ὁμοίως
verses.transliteration: erchetai ho Iēsous kai lambanei ton arton kai didōsin autois kai to opsarion homoiōs
verses.literal: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them and He did the same with the fish
verses.literalPt: Jesus aproximou-se, e, tomando o pão, deu-lhes, e, do mesmo modo, o peixe.

verses.original: Τοῦτο ἤδη τρίτον ἐφανερώθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐγερθεὶς ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Touto ēdē triton ephanerōthē ho Iēsous tois mathētais egertheis ek nekrōn
verses.literal: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead
verses.literalPt: Foi esta já a terceira vez que Jesus se manifestara aos discípulos, depois de ressurgir dentre os mortos.

verses.original: Ὅτε οὖν ἠρίστησαν λέγει τῷ Σίμωνι Πέτρῳ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Σίμων Ἰωάννου ἀγαπᾷς με πλέον τούτων Λέγει αὐτῷ Ναί Κύριε σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε Λέγει αὐτῷ Βόσκε τὰ ἀρνία μου
verses.transliteration: Hote oun ēristēsan legei tō Simōni Petrō ho Iēsous Simōn Iōannou agapas me pleon toutōn Legei autō Nai Kyrie sy oidas hoti philō se Legei autō Boske ta arnia mou
verses.literal: When they had finished eating Jesus asked Simon Peter Simon son of John do you love Me more than these Yes Lord he answered . . . You know I love You Jesus replied . . . Feed My lambs
verses.literalPt: Depois de terem almoçado, perguntou Jesus a Simão Pedro: Simão, filho de João, amas-me mais do que estes? Ele respondeu: Sim, Senhor, tu sabes que te amo. Ele lhe disse: Apascenta os meus cordeiros.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ πάλιν δεύτερον Σίμων Ἰωάννου ἀγαπᾷς με Λέγει αὐτῷ Ναί Κύριε σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε Λέγει αὐτῷ Ποίμαινε τὰ πρόβατά μου
verses.transliteration: Legei autō palin deuteron Simōn Iōannou agapas me Legei autō Nai Kyrie sy oidas hoti philō se Legei autō Poimaine ta probata mou
verses.literal: Jesus asked a second time Simon son of John do you love Me Yes Lord he answered . . . You know I love You Jesus told him Shepherd My sheep
verses.literalPt: Segunda vez, perguntou-lhe Jesus: Simão, filho de João, amas-me? Ele respondeu: Sim, Senhor, tu sabes que te amo. Ele lhe disse: Pastoreia as minhas ovelhas.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον Σίμων Ἰωάννου φιλεῖς με Ἐλυπήθη ὁ Πέτρος ὅτι εἶπεν αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον Φιλεῖς με Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριε πάντα σὺ οἶδας σὺ γινώσκεις ὅτι φιλῶ σε Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Βόσκε τὰ πρόβατά μου
verses.transliteration: Legei autō to triton Simōn Iōannou phileis me Elypēthē ho Petros hoti eipen autō to triton Phileis me Kai eipen autō Kyrie panta sy oidas sy ginōskeis hoti philō se Legei autō ho Iēsous Boske ta probata mou
verses.literal: Jesus asked a third time Simon son of John do you love Me Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time Do you love Me Lord You know all things he replied You know I love You Jesus said to him Feed My sheep
verses.literalPt: Terceira vez, perguntou-lhe Jesus: Simão, filho de João, amas-me? Pedro entristeceu-se por ele lhe ter perguntado pela terceira vez: Amas-me? Respondeu-lhe ele: Senhor, tu conheces todas as coisas; tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe Jesus: Apascenta as minhas ovelhas.

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτε ἦς νεώτερος ἐζώννυες σεαυτὸν καὶ περιεπάτεις ὅπου ἤθελες ὅταν δὲ γηράσῃς ἐκτενεῖς τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ ἄλλος ζώσει σε καὶ οἴσει ὅπου οὐ θέλεις
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō soi hote ēs neōteros ezōnnyes seauton kai periepateis hopou ētheles hotan de gērasēs ekteneis tas cheiras sou kai allos zōsei se kai oisei hopou ou theleis
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you when you were young you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted but when you are old you will stretch out your hands and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go
verses.literalPt: Em verdade, em verdade te digo: quando eras mais moço, cingias-te e andavas por onde querias; mas, quando fores velho, estenderás as tuas mãos, e outro te cingirá e te levará para onde não queres.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ δοξάσει τὸν Θεόν Καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: touto de eipen sēmainōn poiō thanatō doxasei ton Theon Kai touto eipōn legei autō Akolouthei moi
verses.literal: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God And after He had said this He told him Follow Me
verses.literalPt: Disse isso para indicar com que gênero de morte Pedro havia de glorificar a Deus. Depois de assim falar, disse-lhe: Segue-me.

verses.original: Ἐπιστραφεὶς ὁ Πέτρος βλέπει τὸν μαθητὴν ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀκολουθοῦντα ὃς καὶ ἀνέπεσεν ἐν τῷ δείπνῳ ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Κύριε τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδιδούς σε
verses.transliteration: Epistrapheis ho Petros blepei ton mathētēn hon ēgapa ho Iēsous akolouthounta hos kai anepesen en tō deipnō epi to stēthos autou kai eipen Kyrie tis estin ho paradidous se
verses.literal: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask Lord who is going to . . . betray You
verses.literalPt: Virando-se Pedro, viu que o ia seguindo o discípulo a quem Jesus amava, e que durante a ceia se reclinara no seio de Jesus, e perguntara: Senhor, quem é o que te trai?

verses.original: τοῦτον οὖν ἰδὼν ὁ Πέτρος λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ Κύριε οὗτος δὲ τί
verses.transliteration: touton oun idōn ho Petros legei tō Iēsou Kyrie houtos de ti
verses.literal: When Peter saw him he asked . . . . . . Lord what about him
verses.literalPt: Vendo-o Pedro, perguntou a Jesus: Senhor, e a este que sucederá?

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐὰν αὐτὸν θέλω μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι τί πρὸς σέ σύ μοι ἀκολούθει
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Iēsous Ean auton thelō menein heōs erchomai ti pros se sy moi akolouthei
verses.literal: Jesus answered . . . If I want him to remain until I return what is that to you You follow Me
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu-lhe: Se eu quiser que ele fique até eu voltar, que tens tu com isso? Segue-me tu.

verses.original: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν οὗτος ὁ λόγος εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι ὁ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος οὐκ ἀποθνήσκει οὐκ εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι οὐκ ἀποθνήσκει ἀλλ’ Ἐὰν αὐτὸν θέλω μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι τί πρὸς σέ
verses.transliteration: exēlthen oun houtos ho logos eis tous adelphous hoti ho mathētēs ekeinos ouk apothnēskei ouk eipen de autō ho Iēsous hoti ouk apothnēskei all’ Ean auton thelō menein heōs erchomai ti pros se
verses.literal: Because of this the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die However Jesus did not say . . . that he would not die but only If I want him to remain until I return what is that to you
verses.literalPt: Espalhou-se, pois, este boato entre os irmãos de que aquele discípulo não morreria; entretanto, Jesus não disse a Pedro: Ele não morrerá, mas: Se eu quiser que ele fique até eu voltar, que tens tu com isso?

verses.original: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ τούτων καὶ ὁ γράψας ταῦτα καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀληθὴς αὐτοῦ ἡ μαρτυρία ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: Houtos estin ho mathētēs ho martyrōn peri toutōn kai ho grapsas tauta kai oidamen hoti alēthēs autou hē martyria estin
verses.literal: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down And we know that his testimony is true
verses.literalPt: Este é o discípulo que dá testemunho dessas coisas e que as escreveu, e sabemos que o seu testemunho é verdadeiro.

verses.original: Ἔστιν δὲ καὶ ἄλλα πολλὰ ἃ ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἅτινα ἐὰν γράφηται καθ’ ἕν οὐδ’ αὐτὸν οἶμαι τὸν κόσμον χωρήσειν τὰ γραφόμενα βιβλία
verses.transliteration: Estin de kai alla polla ha epoiēsen ho Iēsous hatina ean graphētai kath’ hen oud’ auton oimai ton kosmon chōrēsein ta graphomena biblia
verses.literal: There are many more things . . . that Jesus did If all of them . . . were written down I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written
verses.literalPt: Muitas outras coisas há que fez Jesus; se elas fossem escritas uma por uma, suponho que nem no mundo inteiro caberiam os livros que se escrevessem.
